question: Is familial hypercholesterolemia a weight-related comorbidity (WRC-V1)?
Which drugs are members of the GLP-1 receptor agonist class in MED-RT?
Where is body weight represented in the standardized dataset, and which units are allowed?
Which standards releases does the lab use?

content: SYNTHETIC educational demo (Clinical Study Context & Evidence Lab). CSL-101 is a fictional GLP-1 receptor agonist; studies CSL-A and CSL-B are not real. Data are SDTM-/ADaM-shaped, not submission-ready. Results are descriptive: never state or imply efficacy, superiority or a causal effect.
This space covers ONLY the Clinical Study lab. It has no HEDIS, health-plan, NCQA or care-gap data; if asked about those, say they are out of scope for this space.

Standards and semantics: MONDO diseases, MED-RT drug classes / mechanisms / physiologic effects / contraindications, MeSH (the bridge between MED-RT conditions and MONDO), RxNorm ingredients, CDISC Controlled Terminology, COSMoS biomedical concepts and SDTM dataset specializations. kb_edge holds DIRECT facts only; use the *_closure tables for is-a at any depth (WHERE ancestor_code = X).

Concept class membership (e.g. WRC-V1 weight-related comorbidity) = descendant of a class_root kind='root' and NOT a descendant of any kind='exclude_root' (exclusion wins). WRC-V2 extends WRC-V1 (inherits roots).
Predicates prefixed cpl: are demo extensions, never official CDISC content; standards_manifest lists the pinned releases. MedDRA, SNOMED CT, ATC and the CDISC Library are not used.
Body Weight is COSMoS BC C81328 -> dataset specialization WEIGHT -> SDTM VS variables; allowed units (VSORRESU) are LB, g and kg. Physical data: silver_vs WHERE VSTESTCD = 'WEIGHT'.
gold_eligibility_criterion shows the ontology path that decided each participant's criterion.

question: Is familial hypercholesterolemia a weight-related comorbidity (WRC-V1)?
sql: SELECT c.ancestor_code AS class_root, c.ancestor_name, c.depth FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure c JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.class_root r ON r.concept_id = c.ancestor_code AND r.kind = 'root' AND r.class_id = 'WRC-V1' WHERE c.descendant_code = 'MONDO:0005439' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.mondo_closure x JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.class_root e ON e.concept_id = x.ancestor_code AND e.kind = 'exclude_root' AND e.class_id = 'WRC-V1' WHERE x.descendant_code = c.descendant_code)

question: Which drugs are members of the GLP-1 receptor agonist class in MED-RT?
sql: SELECT k.concept_id, k.label FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge e JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_concept k ON k.concept_id = e.subject WHERE e.predicate = 'medrt:memberOf' AND e.object = 'MEDRT:N0000178480' ORDER BY k.label

question: Where is body weight represented in the standardized dataset, and which units are allowed?
sql: SELECT b.subject AS binding, v.object AS sdtm_variable, u.notation AS allowed_unit FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge h JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge b ON b.subject = h.object AND b.predicate = 'cosmos:constrains' LEFT JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge a ON a.subject = b.subject AND a.predicate = 'cosmos:allowedValue' LEFT JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_concept u ON u.concept_id = a.object JOIN eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.kb_edge v ON v.subject = b.subject AND v.predicate = 'cosmos:constrains' WHERE h.subject = 'COSMOS_DSS:WEIGHT' AND h.predicate = 'cosmos:hasVariableBinding' ORDER BY sdtm_variable, allowed_unit

question: Which standards releases does the lab use?
sql: SELECT artifact_id, publisher, release_version, license_or_terms_reference FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study_standards.standards_manifest ORDER BY artifact_id

question: Why was CSL-A-FX-25 excluded?
sql: SELECT criterion_id, outcome, detail, path_labels FROM eli_test_classic_catalog.clinical_study.gold_eligibility_criterion WHERE USUBJID = 'CSL-A-FX-25' AND outcome IN ('TRIGGERED', 'NOT_MET')
